blocks.text: O'zbek tilida harakat yo'nalishi va joyda bo'lish ikki xil qo'shimcha bilan farqlanadi: Toshkent**ga** boraman (qayerga?) — Toshkent**da** yashayman (qayerda?). Ingliz tilida ham shunday farq bor: yo'nalish — **to**, joyda bo'lish — **in** yoki **at**. Demak, ko'p hollarda `-ga` → **to**, `-da` → **in / at**: go **to** London — London**ga** bormoq; live **in** London — London**da** yashamoq. Lekin bu oddiy qoidaning muhim istisnolari bor: **home** (go home — to'siz) va **arrive** (arrive **in / at** — hech qachon «arrive to» emas). Aynan shu ikki joyda o'zbeklar ko'p xato qiladi.
go to, come to, fly to

Harakatni bildiruvchi fe'llar — go, come, return, walk, drive, fly, travel, move — joy bilan **to** orqali bog'lanadi: walk **to** school, fly **to** Istanbul, move **to** Scotland. Biror narsani yoki kishini biror joyga yuborish va olib borish ham shunday: send a letter **to** the bank, take the children **to** the park. Ot bilan ham: the road **to** Samarkand (Samarqandga boradigan yo'l), my trip **to** London, Welcome **to** Uzbekistan! Kundalik joylar: go **to** work, go **to** school, go **to** bed — artiklsiz (71-dars).

items.text: Could you take these books back **to** the library?
items.translation: Bu kitoblarni kutubxona**ga** qaytarib olib borasizmi?

items.text: Is this the right road **to** the airport?

blocks.text: Manzilga yetib kelgach, endi harakat emas, **joy** haqida gapiramiz — **in** yoki **at** (106–107-darslar): I'm going **to** the post office → Now I'm **at** the post office. Savollarda ham farq aniq: Where are you **going**? — **To** the bank. Where **are** you? — **At** the bank. Shu sababli «stay», «live», «wait», «work» kabi fe'llar bilan **to** ishlatilmaydi: stay **in** a hotel, wait **at** the bus stop.

**home** harakat fe'llari bilan **predlogsiz** ishlatiladi: go **home**, come **home**, get **home**, walk **home**, drive somebody **home**, arrive **home**. O'zbekchada «uy**ga**» deganimiz uchun «go to home» deyish oson — bu xato. Joyda bo'lsak esa **at home**: I'm **at home** («I'm in home» emas).

items.text: Let's **walk home** — it's a lovely evening.
items.translation: Uy**ga** piyoda ketaylik — kechqurun juda yoqimli.

items.text: Dad isn't **at home** yet; he's still **at work**.

blocks.text: **arrive** («yetib kelmoq») yo'nalishni emas, **yetib kelgan joyni** bildiradi, shuning uchun undan keyin **to** emas, **in** yoki **at** keladi. Shahar va mamlakat — **arrive in** (arrive **in** Paris, arrive **in** Japan); bino, bekat, aeroport, tadbir — **arrive at** (arrive **at** the hotel, arrive **at** the airport, arrive **at** the party). Uy — **arrive home**. So'zlashuvda arrive o'rniga ko'pincha **get to** ishlatiladi: What time did you **get to** London? — bu yerda **to** to'g'ri, chunki «get to» = «... ga yetib bormoq». Uy bilan yana to'siz: **get home**.

items.text: Our plane arrives **in** Manchester at noon.
We arrived **at** the concert ten minutes late.
How can I get **to** the bus station from here?
items.translation: Bu yerdan avtovokzal**ga** qanday borsam bo'ladi?

blocks.text: Present Perfect da **been to** «borib kelgan, bo'lgan» degan ma'no beradi: I've **been to** Japan — Yaponiya**da** bo'lganman (hozir qaytib kelganman). **gone to** esa — ketgan va hali o'sha yerda: She's **gone to** the shop — U do'kon**ga** ketdi (hozir u yerda). Batafsil — 17-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «go to home» → **go home**; «arrive to London» → **arrive in London**; «arrive to the station» → **arrive at the station**; «get to home» → **get home**; «I'm going at school.» → **to school**; «Welcome in Uzbekistan!» → **Welcome to Uzbekistan!**; «How can I get the Registan?» → **get to the Registan**.

Qoida-shpargalka: `-ga` → **to** (lekin **home** — hech narsa, **arrive** — **in / at**). `-da` → **in / at**. «arrive» ni «yetib kelib, **o'sha joyda** bo'lmoq» deb tasavvur qiling — shunda **in / at** tabiiy tuyuladi.

Bog'lanish: go to work, go home, go to bed — 71-dars; go to / go on / go for — 55-dars; get ning ma'nolari — 56-dars; in / at / on (joy) — 106–107-darslar; into / out of — 110-dars; Have you ever been to ...? — 17-dars.

examples.title: **go to**, **come to**, **fly to**: cities and countries
examples.description: Harakat fe'llari (go, come, fly, travel, move, return) + **to**: go **to** London — London**ga** bormoq. O'zbekchadagi `-ga` ko'pincha **to** ga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: We're going **to** Samarkand next weekend.
sentences.translation: Kelasi dam olish kunlari Samarqand**ga** boryapmiz.

sentences.text: When did you come **to** Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Toshkent**ga** qachon kelgansiz?

sentences.text: My brother flew **to** Istanbul on business yesterday.
sentences.translation: Akam kecha xizmat safari bilan Istanbul**ga** uchib ketdi.

sentences.text: Emma's family moved **to** Scotland when she was ten.
sentences.translation: Emma o'n yoshligida oilasi Shotlandiya**ga** ko'chib ketgan.

sentences.text: How often do you travel **to** other countries?
sentences.translation: Boshqa mamlakatlar**ga** qanchalik tez-tez sayohat qilasiz?

sentences.text: I'd love to go **to** Japan one day.
sentences.translation: Bir kun kelib Yaponiya**ga** borishni juda istardim.

sentences.text: After ten years in Canada, Aziz returned **to** Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Kanadada o'n yil yashagandan keyin Aziz O'zbekiston**ga** qaytdi.

sentences.text: Thousands of tourists come **to** Bukhara every spring.
sentences.translation: Har bahorda Buxoro**ga** minglab sayyohlar keladi.

sentences.text: Is this the train **to** Manchester? — No, it's the next one.
sentences.translation: Bu Manchester**ga** boradigan poyezdmi? — Yo'q, keyingisi.

sentences.text: Welcome **to** Uzbekistan! I hope you enjoy your stay.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston**ga** xush kelibsiz! Bu yerda yaxshi dam olasiz degan umiddaman.

examples.title: **go to** work, **to** the bank, **to** Aziz's
examples.description: Kundalik joylarga harakat ham **to** bilan: go to work, go to school, go to bed (artiklsiz — 71-dars), go to the bank, go to the doctor's, take somebody to the park.

sentences.text: What time do you go **to** work?
sentences.translation: Ish**ga** soat nechada borasiz?

sentences.text: Dilnoza walks **to** school with her friends every morning.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza har kuni ertalab do'stlari bilan maktab**ga** piyoda boradi.

sentences.text: I'm really tired — I'm going **to** bed.
sentences.translation: Juda charchadim — uxlash**ga** yotaman.

sentences.text: Can you take this parcel **to** the post office?
sentences.translation: Bu posilkani pochta**ga** olib borasizmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod has gone **to** the doctor's because of his back.
sentences.translation: Bekzod beli og'rigani uchun shifokor**ga** ketdi.

sentences.text: Shall we go **to** the cinema after dinner tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqatdan keyin kino**ga** boraylikmi?

sentences.text: Every Sunday we drive **to** my grandparents' for lunch.
sentences.translation: Har yakshanba tushlikka bobo-buvimniki**ga** mashinada boramiz.

sentences.text: I sent an email **to** the hotel, but they haven't replied.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona**ga** elektron xat yubordim, lekin hali javob berishmadi.

sentences.text: Sarah is taking the children **to** the park after lunch.
sentences.translation: Sara tushlikdan keyin bolalarni park**ka** olib boryapti.

sentences.text: On the way **to** the market, we stopped for a cup of tea with an old friend.
sentences.translation: Bozor**ga** ketayotib eski do'stimiz bilan bir piyola choy ichish uchun to'xtadik.

examples.title: **to** (going) or **in** / **at** (being)?
examples.description: Harakat — **to** (`-ga`), joyda bo'lish — **in** / **at** (`-da`): I'm going **to** the bank → I'm **at** the bank.

sentences.text: Where are you going? — **To** the bank.
sentences.translation: Qayerga ketyapsiz? — Bank**ka**.

sentences.text: Where's Aziz? — He's **at** the bank.
sentences.translation: Aziz qayerda? — U bank**da**.

sentences.text: Madina went **to** London in May.
sentences.translation: Madina may oyida London**ga** bordi.

sentences.text: She stayed **in** London for two weeks.
sentences.translation: U London**da** ikki hafta qoldi.

sentences.text: We usually go **to** the market on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Odatda shanba kunlari bozor**ga** boramiz.

sentences.text: I bought these apples **at** the market this morning.
sentences.translation: Bu olmalarni bugun ertalab bozor**dan** oldim.

sentences.text: Tom goes **to** the gym three times a week.
sentences.translation: Tom haftasiga uch marta sport zali**ga** boradi.

sentences.text: He's **at** the gym right now, so call him later.
sentences.translation: U hozir sport zali**da**, shuning uchun keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Are you coming **to** the party on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi ziyofat**ga** kelasizmi?

sentences.text: Everybody had a great time **at** the party, and nobody wanted to leave.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat**da** hamma maza qildi, hech kim ketishni xohlamadi.

examples.title: **go home**, **come home**, **get home**: no **to**
examples.description: **home** dan oldin **to** qo'yilmaydi: go home, come home, get home, walk home — uy**ga**. Lekin joyda bo'lish: **at home** — uy**da**.

sentences.text: It's nearly midnight — let's **go home**.
sentences.translation: Yarim tun bo'lib qoldi — uy**ga** ketaylik.

sentences.text: What time did Bekzod **get home** after the match?
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin Bekzod uy**ga** soat nechada yetib keldi?

sentences.text: My father usually **comes home** at seven.
sentences.translation: Dadam odatda soat yettida uy**ga** keladi.

sentences.text: I was so tired that I took a taxi **home**.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchagan edimki, uy**ga** taksida ketdim.

sentences.text: Bekzod **walks home** from school with his cousin.
sentences.translation: Bekzod maktabdan uy**ga** amakivachchasi bilan piyoda qaytadi.

sentences.text: Are you staying **at home** tonight, or are you going out?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **uyda** qolasizmi yoki biror joyga chiqasizmi?

sentences.text: When Sarah **got home**, the children were already asleep.
sentences.translation: Sara uy**ga** kelganda bolalar allaqachon uxlab qolgan edi.

sentences.text: Can you **drive** me **home** after the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin meni uy**ga** mashinada olib borib qo'yasizmi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza missed her family a lot, so she **went home** for the holidays.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza oilasini juda sog'ingan edi, shuning uchun bayramda uy**ga** ketdi.

sentences.text: Don't forget to send me a message when you **arrive home**.
sentences.translation: Uy**ga** yetib borganingizda menga xabar yuborishni unutmang.

examples.title: **arrive in** a city, **arrive at** a place
examples.description: **arrive** dan keyin hech qachon **to** kelmaydi. Shahar va mamlakat — **arrive in**; bino, bekat, aeroport, tadbir — **arrive at**. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham `-ga`.

sentences.text: We arrived **in** Tashkent late at night.
sentences.translation: Toshkent**ga** kechasi kech yetib keldik.

sentences.text: What time does the plane arrive **at** Heathrow?
sentences.translation: Samolyot Xitrou aeroporti**ga** soat nechada yetib keladi?

sentences.text: The guests arrived **at** the restaurant at eight.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar restoran**ga** soat sakkizda kelishdi.

sentences.text: When Madina arrived **in** England, she didn't know anybody.
sentences.translation: Madina Angliya**ga** kelganda hech kimni tanimas edi.

sentences.text: Please arrive **at** the exam room fifteen minutes early.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, imtihon xonasi**ga** o'n besh daqiqa oldin keling.

sentences.text: Our train arrives **in** Bukhara at 2.30.
sentences.translation: Poyezdimiz Buxoro**ga** soat 2:30 da yetib boradi.

sentences.text: James arrived **at** work an hour late because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Qor sababli Jeyms ish**ga** bir soat kechikib keldi.

sentences.text: Have the new students arrived **at** the hotel yet?
sentences.translation: Yangi talabalar mehmonxona**ga** yetib kelishdimi?

sentences.text: After a long journey, the tourists finally arrived **in** Khiva.
sentences.translation: Uzoq yo'ldan keyin sayyohlar nihoyat Xiva**ga** yetib kelishdi.

sentences.text: Luckily we arrived **at** the stadium just as the match was starting.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiyamki, stadion**ga** aynan o'yin boshlanayotganda yetib keldik.

examples.title: **get to** = reach: How do I get **to** ...?
examples.description: **get to** — «yetib bormoq / kelmoq»: get to the station, get to London. Yo'l so'raganda juda ko'p ishlatiladi. Uy bilan — **get home** (to'siz).

sentences.text: Excuse me, how do I get **to** the Registan?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Registon**ga** qanday borsam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: It takes about forty minutes to get **to** the airport by taxi.
sentences.translation: Aeroport**ga** taksida taxminan qirq daqiqada yetib boriladi.

sentences.text: What time did you get **to** work this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab ish**ga** soat nechada yetib keldingiz?

sentences.text: We got **to** the top of the hill just before sunset.
sentences.translation: Quyosh botishidan sal oldin tepalik cho'qqisi**ga** yetib chiqdik.

sentences.text: How long does it take to get **to** Samarkand on the fast train?
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezdda Samarqand**ga** qancha vaqtda yetib boriladi?

sentences.text: I'll call you as soon as I get **to** the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona**ga** yetib borishim bilan sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

sentences.text: Sarah couldn't get **to** the meeting because her flight was cancelled.
sentences.translation: Reysi bekor qilingani uchun Sara yig'ilish**ga** yetib kela olmadi.

sentences.text: Is it easy to get **to** your village by bus?
sentences.translation: Qishlog'ingiz**ga** avtobusda borish osonmi?

sentences.text: The traffic was terrible, so it took us two hours to get **to** the city centre.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik dahshatli edi, shuning uchun shahar markazi**ga** ikki soatda yetib bordik.

sentences.text: When Bekzod got **to** the station, his train was already leaving.
sentences.translation: Bekzod vokzal**ga** yetib kelganda poyezdi allaqachon jo'nab ketayotgan edi.

examples.title: Have you ever **been to** ...?
examples.description: Present Perfect da **been to** — «borib kelgan, bo'lgan»: I've **been to** London — London**da** bo'lganman. **gone to** — ketgan va hali o'sha yerda.

sentences.text: Have you ever been **to** Khiva? — Yes, twice.
sentences.translation: Hech Xiva**da** bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, ikki marta.

sentences.text: I've never been **to** a football match.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon futbol o'yini**da** bo'lmaganman.

sentences.text: Madina has been **to** London three times, but she's never been **to** Scotland.
sentences.translation: Madina London**da** uch marta bo'lgan, lekin Shotlandiya**da** hech qachon bo'lmagan.

sentences.text: Where's Tom? — He's gone **to** the shop. He'll be back soon.
sentences.translation: Tom qayerda? — Do'kon**ga** ketdi. Tez orada qaytadi.

sentences.text: Where have you been? — **To** the dentist's.
sentences.translation: Qayerda edingiz? — Tish shifokori**da** bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Our teacher has been **to** more than twenty countries.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz yigirmadan ortiq mamlakat**da** bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Has your sister been **to** the new shopping centre yet?
sentences.translation: Opangiz yangi savdo markazi**ga** borib ko'rdimi?

sentences.text: James isn't here — he's gone **to** Paris for a week.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bu yerda yo'q — u bir haftaga Parij**ga** ketgan.

sentences.text: We've been **to** that restaurant before, and the food was excellent.
sentences.translation: U restoran**da** oldin bo'lganmiz, taomlari a'lo edi.

sentences.text: Is this your first visit to Uzbekistan? — No, I've been **to** Tashkent before, but not **to** Samarkand.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonga birinchi kelishingizmi? — Yo'q, oldin Toshkent**da** bo'lganman, lekin Samarqand**da** emas.

examples.title: Mixed: **to**, **in**, **at** or nothing?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: harakat (**to**), joy (**in** / **at**), **arrive in / at**, **get to**, **go home**, **been to**.

sentences.text: Are you going **to** the gym after work? — No, I'm going **home**.
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin sport zali**ga** borasizmi? — Yo'q, uy**ga** ketaman.

sentences.text: How was your trip **to** Bukhara? — Wonderful! We stayed **in** a lovely old hotel.
sentences.translation: Buxoro**ga** safaringiz qanday o'tdi? — Ajoyib! Chiroyli eski mehmonxona**da** qoldik.

sentences.text: Did you arrive **at** the airport on time? — Yes, but the plane was late.
sentences.translation: Aeroport**ga** o'z vaqtida yetib keldingizmi? — Ha, lekin samolyot kechikdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod lives **in** Manchester now, but he comes **to** Tashkent every summer.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hozir Manchester**da** yashaydi, lekin har yozi Toshkent**ga** keladi.

sentences.text: What time did the children get **home** from school?
sentences.translation: Bolalar maktabdan uy**ga** soat nechada kelishdi?

sentences.text: I can't come **to** the meeting — I'm **at** the doctor's at three.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish**ga** kela olmayman — soat uchda shifokor**da** bo'laman.

sentences.text: When we arrived **in** Oxford, it was raining, so we went straight **to** the hotel.
sentences.translation: Oksford**ga** yetib kelganimizda yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun to'g'ri mehmonxona**ga** bordik.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is this the right way **to** the museum?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, muzey**ga** shu yo'ldan boriladimi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza wasn't **at** home when I called — she was **at** her sister's.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda Dilnoza **uyda** yo'q edi — u opasi**nikida** edi.

sentences.text: Have you ever been **to** a wedding in Uzbekistan? — Yes, I went **to** one in Fergana last year.
sentences.translation: Hech O'zbekistonda to'y**da** bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, o'tgan yili Farg'onada bittasi**ga** borganman.
